title: pkix-chain-simple missing re-export of pkix_path
description:
pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs uses pkix_path::Error, TrustAnchor, ValidatedPath in its public API surface (Error::Path variant at line 330, verify_simple signature) but does not re-export pkix_path.

Location: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:72-77, 330
Recommendation: Add pub use pkix_path; to pkix-chain-simple's public API.
